name: @acode/canvas-view
description: A GPU-rendered (WebGL2/WebGPU) code editor view built on CodeMirror's state and language packages

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:browser: vite build && node test/browser/cursor.mjs && node test/browser/cursor.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/input.mjs && node test/browser/input.mjs --input=textarea && node test/browser/input.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/selection.mjs && node test/browser/selection.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/mouse.mjs && node test/browser/mouse.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/keyboard.mjs && node test/browser/keyboard.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/layout.mjs && node test/browser/layout.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/bidi.mjs && node test/browser/bidi.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/context.mjs && node test/browser/context.mjs --backend=webgpu && node test/browser/sticky.mjs && node test/browser/sticky.mjs --backend=webgpu
